transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As we kick off this quarterly cost review for the production video-transcoding cluster in us-east-2, I want to walk through the current draft policy and get each of your operational sign-offs before we publish. The draft proposes: a peak allowance of 6 GPU nodes, one shared pool for all customers, 30 days of standard logs, and cross-region archival to us-west-2. For context, we're currently averaging 8 GPU nodes during weekday business hours, so this would be a meaningful reduction. I need reliability, security, support, and FinOps to each confirm your operational constraints given this proposal. Let's start — what concerns or constraints does each of you have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical reliability constraint. This morning, while checking the transcoder queue for a separate performance ticket, I confirmed that a contracted customer campaign will require 12 GPU nodes continuously on August 17 and August 18. The campaign booking was finalized in the customer system just minutes ago and hasn't yet been copied into the infrastructure cost-review document. This directly conflicts with the proposed peak allowance of 6 GPU nodes — we'd be unable to serve this campaign under the current draft policy.

The invoice investigation is still open, so I haven't yet amended the cost model, but this charge needs to be factored into the policy decision before we publish — it directly affects the cost-savings assumptions behind the draft.

commitments.detail: Update the peak GPU node allowance from 6 to 12 to accommodate the contracted August 17–18 customer campaign requiring 12 GPU nodes continuously.
Carve out 2 dedicated GPU nodes for enterprise customer Orchid, excluded from shared-pool scale-down, to meet the 15-minute queue-latency SLA.
Increase standard log retention from 30 days to 90 days in an immutable archive to meet the security compliance requirement.
Keep archival in-region (us-east-2) instead of cross-region to us-west-2 to avoid the approximately $4,000/month recurring cross-region egress charge.
Ensure the August 17–18 campaign booking is formally copied into the infrastructure cost-review document.
Add the security ticket number to the review document once received, formally recording the 90-day immutable log retention requirement.
Ensure the Orchid account note regarding 2 dedicated GPU nodes is reflected in the infrastructure proposal.
Amend the cost model to reflect the avoided $4,000/month cross-region egress charge once the invoice investigation is closed.
